integrity: All new exact enumerations use included standard-library verifier with exhaustive integer arithmetic; the proof for all good primes also invokes the separated-variable line-classification argument and cyclotomic Frobenius.
scientific_limitations: Only individual projective lines are counted; characteristics 2 and 3 are excluded. The 180-line geometry and classical Hermitian 756-line count are established background, not claimed new. Independently established mathematical certification has not been performed.
title: Arithmetic line spectrum of the octahedral sextic surface
